criteria.requirement: For fixture index i=0…30, set angle=`Math.PI/2+(i+1)*2*Math.PI/32`, position=`(50*cos(angle),50*sin(angle),0)`, and name=`coin-${i}`.
criteria.action: Load the page and inspect the ship, track, and all coin meshes before stepping.
criteria.expected: There are 31 correctly named coins at the specified radius-50 positions; ship is at (0,50,0) with rotation.z=Math.PI/2. (Tolerance: 1e-5 per coordinate and angle)

criteria.action: Call reset(), then step(1000), and inspect state and the live ship transform.
criteria.expected: time=1000 and angle=Math.PI/2+1.4; ship position is (50*cos(angle),50*sin(angle),0) and rotation.z equals angle. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: then spawn a ball at radius 0 whenever time is divisible by 750
criteria.action: Call reset(), then step(1000), and inspect cannonball state and mesh position.
criteria.expected: Exactly one automatic ball exists at angle 0, radius 8.75, and world position (8.75,0,0). (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: collect every visible coin whose ship-to-coin Euclidean distance is <=6
criteria.action: Reset, call step(54), inspect score, then call step(1) and inspect score and coin-0.
criteria.expected: At t=54 score and collectedCount are 0 and coin-0 is visible; at t=55 score and collectedCount are 1 and coin-0 is invisible. (Tolerance: Exact integer state; geometric threshold tolerance 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: `toggleDirection()` multiplies direction by -1 and immediately updates ship rotation.
criteria.action: Reset, toggle direction, inspect rotation, step(10), then reset and inspect all public state and groups.
criteria.expected: After toggling, direction=-1 and rotation.z=angle-Math.PI; after 10 ms angle=Math.PI/2-0.014. Reset restores every initial value, 31 visible coins, and zero balls. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: otherwise throw RangeError without changing state
criteria.action: Reset, snapshot getState(), call step(1.5), step(-1), and step(10001), then spawn a colliding ball and attempt step(10).
criteria.expected: Each invalid step throws RangeError and preserves the snapshot. spawnBall(Math.PI/2,50) followed by step(1) sets status=destroyed; subsequent step(10) leaves time and transforms unchanged. (Tolerance: Exact state equality)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
